This sheet details the overall amount of challenges per season, including:
- Route Infos
- Road Blocks
- Detours
- Fast Forwards
- Speed Bumps
- Hazards
- City Sprints
- Express Pass Challenges
- Fork in the Roads
To see specific information on each challenge, check out their respective sheets :)

*NOTE: Types of challenges are headed where they were first introduced, and counts for challenges are cut off on the last season they were used. For instance, Speed Bumps were introduced in Season 12 and were last used in Season 33.
*NOTE: The Hazard, City Sprint, and Express Pass challenges are not explained on their own, so that will be included here:

unnamed_2: The Hazard was an additional task given in Leg 1 of Season 19 and Season 38 for the team who came in last in the first challenge of the race.

The City Sprint was only used on Leg 10 of Season 32, and required teams to complete all tasks together meaning 
no Road Blocks or Detours, effectively serving as an all Route Info leg.

In Season 35 and 37, teams had the chance to win the Express Pass by completing an extra task, instead of coming in first on a specific leg. Thus, this is a signifier of a separate, voluntary challenge teams could complete in this Season.
Basically a Detour. Introduced in Season 37, it forces all teams to pick a challenge path to follow, leading to different mats at the Pit Stop.
